user.title: Set up BRight
user.description: This integration talks to the BRight add-on running on this Home Assistant host. It adds the party_mode, start_party, start_show and stop_show services and a show-status sensor.

confirm.title: BRight discovered
confirm.description: Confirm setup to enable the light-show services and status sensor.

party_mode.name: Start party mode
party_mode.description: Play the configured (or given) music folder on a media player and run each track's compiled light show in sync.

media_player.name: Media player
media_player.description: Which media player plays the music. Defaults to the last one calibrated.

folder.name: Music folder
folder.description: Folder under /media to play. Defaults to the add-on's music_folder option.

vibe.name: Vibe
vibe.description: Optional steer for the director, e.g. "chill", "rave", "halloween".

party.name: Saved party
party.description: Name of a party saved in the BRight panel. Its speaker, folder, vibe, light selection and end scene are used; anything given here wins over what the party saved.

end_scene.name: End scene
end_scene.description: A scene to call when the party stops, instead of restoring every light to how it was before.

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Play the folder in a random order. On by default.

start_show.name: Start a show
start_show.description: Play one track and its compiled light show.

media_player.name: Media player
media_player.description: Which media player plays the music. Defaults to the last one calibrated.

stop_show.name: Stop the show
stop_show.description: Stop playback and put the room back — restoring every light to its pre-show state, or calling a scene if one is given (or if the running party named one).

scene.name: End scene
scene.description: Call this scene instead of restoring the lights. Use it when the show was the evening and what comes next is bedtime.

start_party.name: Start a saved party
start_party.description: Run a party saved in the BRight panel, by name — its speaker, music folder, vibe, lights and end scene were set up once and are reused.

party.name: Party
party.description: The saved party's name, as it appears in the panel's Party tab.

media_player.name: Media player
media_player.description: Override the speaker this party normally plays on.

end_scene.name: End scene
end_scene.description: Override the scene called when this party stops.
